claim: Researchers at Facebook AI, UCL and NYU coin "retrieval-augmented generation" (RAG): fetch relevant passages first, then let the model write its answer from them.
sourceTitle: Lewis et al., Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks (arXiv)

claim: GPT-4 launches with a context window of 8,192 tokens, plus limited access to a 32,768-token version (about 50 pages of text).
sourceTitle: OpenAI, GPT-4

claim: Anthropic expands Claude's context window from 9K to 100K tokens, around 75,000 words.
sourceTitle: Anthropic, Introducing 100K Context Windows

claim: OpenAI adds function calling to its chat API, the start of models calling tools. The standard gpt-3.5-turbo window is 4k tokens, with a new 16k version.
sourceTitle: OpenAI, Function calling and other API updates

claim: Lost in the Middle: models answer best when the relevant fact sits at the start or end of a long prompt, and significantly worse when it sits in the middle.
sourceTitle: Liu et al., Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts (arXiv)

claim: GPT-4 Turbo is announced with a 128K context window.
sourceTitle: OpenAI, New models and developer products announced at DevDay

claim: Claude 2.1 doubles its limit to 200,000 tokens.
sourceTitle: Anthropic, Introducing Claude 2.1

claim: Microsoft Research introduces GraphRAG: retrieval over a knowledge graph of entities and relationships that a model builds from your documents.
sourceTitle: Microsoft Research, GraphRAG: Unlocking LLM discovery on narrative private data

claim: Gemini 1.5 Pro ships with a standard 128,000-token window and runs up to 1 million tokens in preview.
sourceTitle: Google, Our next-generation model: Gemini 1.5

claim: UC Berkeley launches the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard, about 2,000 test cases measuring how well models call tools.
sourceTitle: Gorilla, Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard

claim: Anthropic's Claude 3 models launch with a 200K-token context window, with inputs over 1 million tokens offered to select customers.
sourceTitle: Anthropic, Introducing the next generation of Claude

claim: Google opens a 2 million-token context window on Gemini 1.5 Pro to all developers.
sourceTitle: Google for Developers, New features for the Gemini API and Google AI Studio

claim: Berkeley's multi-turn tool-calling tests find models "still struggle with breaking down tasks and making the correct implicit calls in more complex scenarios."
sourceTitle: Gorilla, BFCL V3: Multi-Turn & Multi-Step Function Calling

claim: Contextual Retrieval: adding context to each chunk before indexing cuts failed retrievals by 49%, and by 67% with reranking.
sourceTitle: Anthropic, Introducing Contextual Retrieval

claim: Anthropic open-sources the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a standard way to connect AI assistants to tools and data.
sourceTitle: Anthropic, Introducing the Model Context Protocol

claim: Anthropic describes the building block of agents as a model enhanced with retrieval, tools and memory: retrieval is one augmentation among several.
sourceTitle: Anthropic, Building effective agents

claim: OpenAI's Responses API ships built-in tools for agents: web search, file search and computer use. File search is now one tool the model chooses to call.
sourceTitle: OpenAI, New tools for building agents

claim: Meta's Llama 4 Scout offers a 10M-token context window.
sourceTitle: Meta AI, The Llama 4 herd

claim: GPT-4.1 processes up to 1 million tokens of context, up from 128,000 for GPT-4o.
sourceTitle: OpenAI, Introducing GPT-4.1 in the API

claim: Berkeley's leaderboard adds web-search tasks and finds accuracy drops dramatically without tool use: most models need external search to succeed.
sourceTitle: Gorilla, BFCL V4: Web Search

claim: On Berkeley's agent-memory tests with a vector store, scores range from 63.87% for the top model to 5.16% for the lowest: tool use is still far from perfect.
sourceTitle: Gorilla, BFCL V4: Memory

claim: Claude Sonnet 4 supports up to 1 million tokens of context on the Anthropic API.
sourceTitle: Anthropic, Claude Sonnet 4 now supports 1M tokens of context

claim: As of October 2026, every current Claude model lists a 1M-token context window, roughly 555k words.
sourceTitle: Anthropic, Models overview (Claude docs)
